0.0.n: This time word needs no particle here.

0.1.n: 起きる becomes 起きたら to mark what happens before the next action.

0.2.n: This introduces the first step in the routine.

0.4.n: Japanese leaves out whose hair it is because the context makes it clear.

0.5.n: を shows what gets combed and dampened.

0.6.n: The て-form of とかす connects combing to the next action.

0.7.n: 濡らす in the て-form plus おきます means doing something beforehand; ます makes it polite.

1.0.n: あと refers to what comes after the steps just described.

1.1.n: は marks あと as the topic, introducing what happens next.

1.2.n: This is an English loanword written in katakana.

1.3.n: を shows what the speaker works into the hair.

1.4.n: なじませる means making something blend in; ておいて adds preparation and connects to the next step.

2.0.n: 全体的 describes coverage of the whole head of hair rather than just one area.

2.1.n: に turns 全体的 into a phrase describing how widely the oil spreads.

2.2.n: This refers back to the hair oil already mentioned.

2.3.n: が identifies what spreads through the hair.

2.4.n: 行き渡る becomes 行き渡ったら to make complete distribution the condition for the next step.

3.0.n: This tells us how much the speaker twists the hair.

3.1.n: The て-form of ねじる links twisting to clipping; hair is the understood object.

3.3.n: This loanword refers to the tool used to hold the hair in place.

3.4.n: で marks the clip as the tool used for fastening.

3.5.n: 留める plus ておきます means fastening it and leaving it that way; ます makes it polite.

0.lit: Morning, when I wake up, first, hair I comb and dampen beforehand.
0.tip: ておきます shows that an action is done in preparation for something later.

1.lit: After that, hair oil I work in beforehand, and…
1.tip: The ending ておいて connects this preparatory action to the next part of the routine.

2.lit: Once the oil has spread throughout the whole area…
2.tip: たら here means once a step is complete, not that it happened in the past.

3.lit: A little I twist it, and with a clip I fasten it and leave it.
3.tip: で identifies the tool used: the hair is secured with a clip.
